text: ahampi taṃ evameva byākareyyaṃ yathā taṃ ānandena byākataṃ eso ceva tassa attho evañca naṃ dhāreyyāthāti . tatiyaṃ . [173] pubbe me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa #1 ma. paṭipucchimha . bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi ye mayhaṃ pañca kāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā tatra me cittaṃ bahulaṃ gacchamānaṃ gaccheyya paccuppannesu vā appaṃ vā anāgatesu . tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave etadahosi ye mayhaṃ bhikkhave pañca kāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā tatra me
